descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-19 ER 4; TFA-92597 rule 7 · “A dose change renames the row and keeps history.”. Mixed: stated part — furosemide renamed to 40 mg with 80 kept as history; our part — whether 'Resume apixaban this evening' may make it active today (Q19) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B06 · S0 · known

After dictating 'furosemide down to 20', the tracker row still says 'Furosemide 40'; the dose is not updated

Tickets: TFA-92597 ready for qa (R7) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-19/S07, TC-19/S11

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S28 Existing spec that asserts the opposite of ER 4: 'dose changes and resumes are visible in the medication tracker after reload'

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row). (UAT TC-19 ER 4; TFA-92597 R7)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status. (UAT TC-19 ER 2; TFA-92597 R1)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Tim's chromium test in e2e/medication-detection.spec.ts: Hospital patient with Furosemide 80 mg IV active, Eliquis 5 mg held 'Held for procedure' and Amlodipine 5 mg; the model answered at the socket with a decrease and a resume

When Save & Extract 'Decrease furosemide from 80 mg to 40 mg. Resume apixaban this evening.', then reload

Then Per UAT ER 4 / TFA-92597 R7 the furosemide row should be renamed to 40 mg with 80 kept as history. Whether 'Resume apixaban this evening' may make Eliquis active today is Q19

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Read inverted: the test finds the furosemide row by its old exact name 'Furosemide 80 mg IV' (Changed), so a green result means the row was NOT renamed: evidence against U7 on Save & Extract, never a Pass of U7. When R7 is fixed on the event path this lookup is expected to go red and the test must change with the fix (Q18). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
